description: Code-first platform for workflows, apps and AI agents, on the fastest self-hostable orchestrator (benchmarked against Airflow, Prefect and Temporal). Business teams build with AI, engineers control what ships. Open-source alternative to Lovable, Retool and n8n.

sources.entry: Windmill | Turn scripts into workflows, UIs and scheduled jobs

summary.one_liner: Windmill is a self-hostable, code-first platform that turns Python, TypeScript, Go, Bash and other scripts into workflows, UIs, APIs and cron jobs, with AI-assisted app building and Git-based review.
summary.what_it_does: Scripts written in 20+ languages (Python, TypeScript, Go, Bash, SQL, GraphQL, PowerShell, Rust and more) have their typed parameters turned into generated forms, HTTP endpoints and CLI commands. Scripts can be chained into flows, data pipelines, AI agents, or full-code React and Svelte apps. Triggers include schedules, webhooks, HTTP routes, Kafka, WebSockets and email. The platform offers managed Postgres data tables, DuckDB and DuckLake data querying, and secrets/resources permissioned by path. Engineers sync code with Git and use the CLI, VS Code extension or an MCP server, while AI sessions let business users build scripts, flows and apps in a workspace fork with a diff to review before deploying. Workers run jobs pulled from a Postgres queue, sandboxed with nsjail and PID namespaces, and can be grouped by tag for separate networks or environments.
use_cases: Turn scripts into internal tools and UIs
Schedule cron jobs and automated tasks
Orchestrate data pipelines and dbt projects
Build AI agents with reviewed deployment
Self-host an alternative to Retool, n8n or Temporal
how_to_run: Open the instance and log in with admin@windmill.dev / changeme (default credentials; change them)
helm repo add windmill <URL from README> && helm install windmill-chart windmill/windmill --namespace=windmill --create-namespace
notable: Scripts automatically become forms, APIs and CLI commands from their typed signatures
Workflows as code: each task runs as its own job, and waiting for approval releases the worker
AI sessions build apps in a workspace fork with live preview and diff review before deploy
Workers pull jobs by tag so dev and prod workers can run in separate networks
Benchmarked by the authors as faster than Airflow, Prefect and Temporal for two flow types
caveats: Licence is AGPLv3 for the build without the enterprise flag, but the README says commercial licence is needed to sell or serve it as a managed service; enterprise features and dedicated instances are paid
The README says the project is not currently seeking outside code contributions; only bug reports, feature requests and small fix PRs are accepted
Pipelines are marked alpha; Deno and PHP are only on the windmill-full images
